messages:
Tess: Heads-up — small but noisy inconsistency found in snippets: some examples use `user_text`, others `user_input` and `prompt_text`. We should pick one canonical API field and publish guidance.
Rohan: prefer `user_input` (explicit, cross-surface).
Ivy: +1 `user_input`. Can we also add a short note in the style guide about when to use "instruction" vs 'prompt' vs 'user_input' in prose? That helps writers.
Tess: I'll open a PR to update snippets under /docs/examples and add a migration note. I'll also ask for a one-release Console helper: keep label 'Prompt' but show small help text 'API: user_input (was prompt_text)'.
Mae: I'll add SDK snippet diffs for JS/Python and a CI snippet-test. Example to include in migration guide: ```js
// before
client.generate({ prompt_text: 'Summarize' })
// after
client.generate({ user_input: 'Summarize' })
```
Rohan: DocsBot, can you run a scoped scan for code fences in /docs/examples and open PRs for straightforward replacements?
DocsBot: queued: scanning code fences in /docs/examples and /docs/snippets for deprecated param names. Will open automated fix branches and post links here.
Ivy: Also add a glossary row: 'user_input — raw text provided by user. Use "instruction" for imperative model commands; avoid 'prompt' in API reference.'
Tess: Action items: Tess — PR + migration paragraph; Mae — SDK snippets & tests; Rohan — release-note checklist & PM tag; Ivy — glossary blurb. We'll merge after CI green and keep compatibility shims for one release. :thumbsup:
